articles.summary: Jeppesen ForeFlight and Archer are embarking on the first phase of integrating Archer’s ZEE AI Foundation Model into ForeFlight Mobile to enable real-time Air Traffic Control (ATC transcription) in the leading electronic flight bag product for general aviation pilots. The integration uses Archer’s ZEE to turn spoken ATC instructions into readable text on iPad in real-time – helping pilots confirm clearances and catch errors to avoid incidents and improve safety. Optimized for Apple silicon, ZEE leverages on-device intelligence to deliver real-time transcription on iPad, a device already trusted in cockpits around the world, with no reliance on connectivity. Jeppesen ForeFlight and Archer are working together on this new AI product integration and plan to share more early next year. articles.summary: Archer and Formula 1 announced a multi-year partnership for Archer to be at select Grands Prix events that align with key commercial markets they plan to operate in across the US, Middle East, Asia and Europe. The partners plan to explore the future integration of eVTOL air taxi services at Grand Prix events with the goal of flying VIPs and fans to and from Grand Prix circuits in minutes aboard Midnight. ( Watch Video ) Today, Archer (NYSE: ACHR) and Formula 1 announced a multi-year partnership for Archer to be at select Grands Prix events that align with key commercial markets the company plans to operate in across the US, Middle East, Asia and Europe. Additionally, the partners plan to explore the future integration of eVTOL air taxi services at Grand Prix events with the goal of flying VIPs and fans to and from Grand Prix circuits in minutes aboard Midnight.
